This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block.

This equipment consists of six (6)
double cases centrifugal P/P having twin suction first stages inter mediate
press. Bleed off from first stage, booster stage bleed - off

هذه الوثيقة معتمدة من قبل المهندس.

Technical
Specification for Boiler feed pump:

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker for
electrical equipments.
Close the suction and discharge valves.
